basic_details.job_title: ICAR-CRIDA Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The ICAR-Central Research Institute for Dryland Agriculture (ICAR-CRIDA) will hold a Written Test / walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 (Wednesday); candidates must report by 10.00 hrs at ICAR-CRIDA, Santoshnagar, Hyderabad- 500059. Three Young Professional - I positions (2 under the INSTITUTE budget and 1 under the OADMP budget) are to be filled under Advertisement No. 22/2026/CRIDA, each with emoluments of Rs. 30,000/- per month (consolidated).

age_limit.details: The age limit for all three positions is minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, with relaxation as per rules. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: BCom/ BBA/BBS with Minimum 60 % marks from a recognized university/college
B.Tech/ B.Sc (Computers) with Minimum 60 % marks from a recognized university/college

Position Code 02: Knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word/Excel/Tally/PowerPoint). | The age limit for all three positions is minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, with relaxation as per rules. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. | Both position codes carry emoluments of Rs. 30,000/- per month (consolidated). The position is purely temporary for the duration of six months or co-terminus with the project. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each position code.

important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The decision of the Director, CRIDA shall be final and binding on applicants. For further updates, the notice asks candidates to regularly visit the institute's website, www.icar-crida.res.in.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists the three Young Professional - I positions under two position codes, which differ in budget and qualification. Position Code 01: Knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word/Excel/Tally/PowerPoint) / CA (Inter) / ICWA (Inter) / CS (Inter). Position Code 02: Knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word/Excel/Tally/PowerPoint). The age limit for all three positions is minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, with relaxation as per rules. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Both position codes carry emoluments of Rs. 30,000/- per month (consolidated). The position is purely temporary for the duration of six months or co-terminus with the project. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each position code.

rows.essential_qualification: BCom/ BBA/BBS with Minimum 60 % marks from a recognized university/college
B.Tech/ B.Sc (Computers) with Minimum 60 % marks from a recognized university/college

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Non-production of any of the original certificates will lead to rejection of candidature. A Provisional Certificate for Graduation will be accepted only from candidates whose year of passing is 2025/26.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at ICAR-CRIDA, Santoshnagar, Hyderabad by 10.00 hrs on 25 November 2026. Candidates reporting after 10.00 hrs shall not be permitted to appear for the selection process. If required, a preliminary screening test (MCQs based) may be conducted for shortlisting. The interview follows on the same day, and original certificates are verified at the time of interview. Final selection shall be based on interview performance.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The decision of the Director, CRIDA shall be final and binding on applicants. For further updates, the notice asks candidates to regularly visit the institute's website, www.icar-crida.res.in .

faq.question: Q1. When is the ICAR-CRIDA Young Professional - I walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The Written Test / walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026 (Wednesday).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the ICAR-CRIDA walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates must report by 10.00 hrs at ICAR-CRIDA, Santoshnagar, Hyderabad- 500059; those reporting after 10.00 hrs shall not be permitted to appear.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CRIDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 Young Professional - I positions: 2 under Position Code 01 (INSTITUTE budget) and 1 under Position Code 02 (OADMP budget).

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for ICAR-CRIDA Young Professional - I?
faq.answer: Position Code 01 needs BCom/BBA/BBS and Position Code 02 needs B.Tech/B.Sc (Computers), each with minimum 60% marks from a recognized university/college.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ICAR-CRIDA Young Professional - I?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, with relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of ICAR-CRIDA Young Professional - I?
faq.answer: Both positions carry emoluments of Rs. 30,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the ICAR-CRIDA walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the filled-in application form as per the attached format, self-attested copies of certificates and all original certificates including marks memos; a Custodian Certificate is needed if originals are deposited with a College/University/Employer.

faq.question: Q8. How will ICAR-CRIDA select Young Professional - I candidates?
faq.answer: A preliminary MCQ-based screening test may be conducted for shortlisting if required, followed by the interview on the same day; final selection is based on interview performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ICAR-CRIDA Young Professional - I job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary for the duration of six months or co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q10. Will ICAR-CRIDA pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
